scope: Shared material assignments and physical-meter UVs only; geometry, transforms, layout, lighting, camera and exposure are preserved.
review: Native material samples and same-camera host studies inspected in bright sun and shade. Final render/PDF review is recorded separately in output-validation.json.
texture_design: Per-object tone/phase, grain aligned to longest local mesh axis, fine wandering growth lines, elongated pores and matte roughness.
ifc_representation: IFC stores matching flat display colors; the detailed procedural grain and roughness are in the editable Blender materials.
